newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - ACCC clears IAMA bid for Primac.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - ACCC clears IAMA bid for Primac.

text.p: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC ) will not oppose the proposed acquisition of Primac Holdings Ltd by IAMA Ltd, acting ACCC chairman Allan Asher said on Sunday.
The ACCC found the rural merchandise market in which both companies are involved appeared to be competitive in the relevant markets of Queensland and northern New South Wales, he said in a statement.
IAMA is offering nine of its shares for every 10 Primac shares.
Primac last week recommended shareholders take no action on the bid pending further advice.
It said that IAMA's Part A offer document had major deficiences which made it impossible for shareholders to make a sensible investment decision.
